title: Hold a licence to deal with genetically modified organisms
what: Dealing with a GMO needs a GMO licence from the Gene Technology Regulator, unless the dealing is otherwise authorised under the Act.

sources.title: Gene Technology Act 2000
sources.quote: 32 Person not to deal with a GMO without a licence (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person deals with a GMO, knowing that it is a GMO; and (b) the dealing with the GMO by the person is not authorised by a GMO licence

reach.condition: if it deals with genetically modified organisms

assessment.summary: Research and commercial work with GMOs needs the Regulator's licence, after risk assessment.

marks.reason: A licence, after risk assessment, is needed before dealing with a GMO.
Licensing time and data requirements slow new gene technology products.
